=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:2357-2369, 14456-14466 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: An unauthenticated state-marker comment can permanently block crash-recovery reconstruction when no trusted state comment exists.
  WHY: The reconstruction gate treats any untrusted marker as a permanent blocker, so the poller skips reconstruction on every cycle with no recovery path or operator-visible alert; severity is BLOCKER in mistralai_mistral-small-2603 and MAJOR in the other reports.
- scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:460-491 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The resolver preparation script accepts the newest ORCHESTRATOR_STATE_V1 comment without authenticating its author.
  WHY: An unauthenticated commenter can forge fingerprints and must_contain/must_not_contain data that steers the resolver model's edits and token-backed commits; severity is BLOCKER in mistralai_mistral-small-2603 and MAJOR in the other reports.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:2330-2331, 14460-14463 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: Enforcing integration-branch binding while reading state makes state for customized or non-conforming integration branches unreadable and freezes the entire project loop.
  WHY: The read-time validation and skip gate block all phases rather than only fetch, commit, and push operations, preventing self-heal and emitting only a warning; severity is BLOCKER in mistralai_mistral-small-2603 and MAJOR in moonshotai_kimi-k3.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:6631, 8085 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The generic sync guard emits branch-binding rejection under the contractual SYNC_LIST_UNION_V1 log prefix.
  WHY: Workflow-log-analysis and drift-audit tooling can misattribute generic sync rejections as list-union outcomes, polluting metrics and incident-triage attribution.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:6717-6736, 6720-6734, 6728-6731 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The helper timeout classification recognizes exit codes 124 and 137 but not conventional exit code 143.
  WHY: A helper terminated by SIGTERM can be logged as helper_rejected rather than helper_timeout, undercounting timeout metrics even though control flow reaches the existing resolver path.
- scripts/sync_contract_list_union.py:300 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The timeout exit handling does not classify exit code 143 as a timeout.
  WHY: A SIGTERM handler producing 143 is misclassified as ineligible rather than failed:helper_timeout, causing timeout-class metrics to be undercounted.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  expected_change_site: scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh (fingerprint extraction)

  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_6]
  EVIDENCE: scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:460-491 still uses an unauthenticated jq path feeding INTEGRATION_FINGERPRINTS_JSON

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:2357-2369 (EXTRACTED_STATE_UNTRUSTED_MARKER_COUNT computation), 14456-14466 (reconstruction gate) | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: If no trusted state comment exists and an attacker floods the issue with unauthenticated comments matching the state-marker regex, EXTRACTED_STATE_UNTRUSTED_MARKER_COUNT becomes positive and trusted_comments_json becomes empty.
  WHY: The reconstruction gate fires every tick and permanently blocks the only recovery path until a trusted actor deletes the attacker's comments.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:6631, 8085 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The generic sync guard and the same check in sync_contract_list_union_merge emit branch-binding rejection under the SYNC_LIST_UNION_V1 stable log prefix.
  WHY: Workflow-log-analysis and drift-audit tooling misattribute non-list-union sync rejections as list-union outcomes.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:6717-6736 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The helper exit-code branch recognizes exit codes 124 and 137 but not conventional exit code 143.
  WHY: A SIGTERM exit via a shell wrapper is classified as helper_rejected instead of helper_timeout, undercounting actual timeouts.

=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
